input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: Section 9.4 gives us an unrestricted convenience right over the Agreement or any Order Form, and Section 29.4 fixes that notice period at thirty days — matching the preferred 30-day standard. There is no early-termination fee or penalty: we owe only accrued Fees, and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (reinforced by Section 10.2). Vendor has no convenience right: its termination rights in Sections 9.1–9.2 are limited to uncured material breach and insolvency, and Section 8.2 gives only Customer the non-renewal right, so Vendor cannot walk away during the three-year term (Section 8.1). Sections 10 and 11 impose no wind-down or exit charges beyond transition assistance at Order Form rates at our request. The clause sits at the preferred position; no redline needed.
